title: Blue Shark
text: “Usaunny buns are curry buns, indeed!”
“No one asked. Why curry, though?”
“Huh? Well… maybe because it’s something Motoyasu-kun is good at?”
They’d gone with something curry-related, which Father had praised even while scolding him for using too much spice, indeed!
“What’s inside the Peckul bun?”
“Standard sweet bean paste.”
“There’s no Riska bun!”
“Of course there isn’t!”
Ren latched onto this for some mysterious reason and locked eyes with Itsuki in a staring contest, indeed.
“I made these because I didn’t want anyone to feel left out. Here, Itsuki.”
Father pulled a Riska-faced Riska bun out of the steamer and held it out to Itsuki. I saw with my own eyes that Father had made it properly, indeed.
“The filling’s pizza bun style. Or would you have preferred sweet bean paste for the Riska bun? In that case, maybe I should put cream or jam in the Peckul bun instead?”
“Don’t waste your consideration on me! Why does the Riska product outnumber the others by one!”
“Squishy-squish, Mel-chan. Which one do you want to eat?”
“They all look delicious.”
“Looks like we could line them all up and try one of each!”
Sakura-chan was arranging Father’s finished prototypes on a plate, gazing at them, indeed. She was clearly waiting for Father’s permission to eat.
“Heh… so this really is something Naofumi-kun made, huh?”
“Fweeh… Rafuemon-san, we mustn’t let Itsuki-sama hear that, or it’ll be terrible…”
The moment Rafuemon muttered that under her breath, Itsuki shot her a glare, indeed. A preemptive strike from the future, so to speak.
“Please keep developing more local specialty products. And if possible, in a way that keeps the Riska product line the smallest.”
“I want more Usaunny products!”
“That’s a lot of demands, huh…”
“Mother would probably be thrilled to buy them… she collects souvenir pennants and things like that.”

At Fiancée’s words, I suddenly recalled the time the Queen had gone chasing after Filolial Cross merchandise, indeed. According to Father, the Queen was quite the fangirl. If something became popular, she’d surely buy it. Above all, Melromarc was in dire financial straits thanks to the Crimson Swine’s doings, so there was a strong chance the profits from Cal Mira Island could go toward reconstruction, indeed. Even now, attention was gathering around the village we’d helped rebuild—plenty of tourists were flocking to the neighboring town, too. And so, with the product development session wrapped up, it was decided that Father would head underwater, indeed.
“For the underwater monsters… you should just do instant-changes to bring out floating weapons and take them down as you go. Ren-san and Motoyasu-san, please take turns.”
“Why is Itsuki the one giving orders here…”
“Quite so, indeed. That said, drop confirmations can be checked via the Monster Book, so anything unnecessary can be ignored, indeed. Father’s underwater movement is quite fast, after all.”
“Leave it to me!”

Father shot forward, gliding briskly through the underwater stage, indeed. As expected of Father! He dove at the same speed as when he went to the ocean depths with Older Sister, indeed. And it seemed any monsters that approached got their movements locked up by Peckul’s unique ability as he pressed onward.
“Huh, looks like I’ve ended up somewhere that seems like a boss battle area… and also… how should I put it. There’s this blatant fish-mark field.”
By all appearances, it looked designated for Peckuls only, indeed.
“There’s probably a boss fight ahead, but if only Naofumi-san can enter, isn’t that basically a dead end?”
“What if we wore costumes and tried to get in!?”
“We already tested that. Couldn’t get in.”
We’d tried that experiment at Father’s suggestion when expanding racial abilities, indeed. We thought maybe wearing each other’s costumes might let us transform species, but it hadn’t worked.
“So the problem we worried about has come up. A spot where it’s impossible without Naofumi-san, and thus a dead end…”
“Well… it’ll take time, but I’ll try my trump card. Thanks to Ren and Motoyasu-kun leveling up the lantern, the number of shields I can transform into has grown quite a bit.”
With that, Father transformed into a shield with a counterattack ability, indeed.
“So this is a battle only Naofumi-san can fight. We don’t know what kind of attacks the enemy will use, but please go for it!”
“I know.”
“Go get ’em, Naofumi!”
“Fight on, Shield Hero-sama!”
“Do your best, nano!”

Sakura-chan and Fiancée cheered him on, and Rival—don’t you dare get close to Father, indeed! Father slipped smoothly into the boss room, indeed. With the screen displaying that only Peckuls could act and no swapping was allowed, what waited in the room was an oversized blue shark—some kind of monster called a Blue Shark Robbery, indeed. With a splash, it burst up through the water’s surface, having just torn into a striped fish—something like a large black porgy—as its grand entrance, indeed.
“If there’s a water surface, you’d think member-changes would be possible…”
Itsuki’s point was quite reasonable, indeed.
“Alright, here I go! Pe-yan! Just kidding!”
Father closed in on the Blue Shark Robbery, equipping a counterattack-effect shield—this time one with spikes, the very shield he’d once used against Itsuki, brought back to memory, indeed.
“Gaaah!”

The Blue Shark Robbery reared its head back to bite down—chomp!—but Father dodged and instead took the blow from its fin. The spikes on Father’s equipped shield were sharp and pierced deep, indeed. Had that dealt damage? Hard to tell just from the screen, indeed.
“Hmm. Status ailments seem to have less effect? Should I keep it up… or just go with a straightforward counter build?”

Father wove circles through the water at high speed, toying with the Blue Shark Robbery, indeed. The whirlpool created by his rapid movement sent the Blue Shark Robbery spinning round and round underwater, indeed.
“Naofumi-san can really move well, huh.”
“I figured a tank’s whole job was enduring hits, but hey, he pulls it off.”

“Apparently Father says things like ‘There’s no rule saying the Shield Hero can’t dodge, right?’ and dodges sometimes, indeed. The idea is that he endures when protecting someone, but dodges when he himself is the target.”
“I see… so he endures because he’s covering for someone, but dodges when he’s the one being targeted.”
“That’s rational.”
Situational judgment mattered greatly, indeed.
“This is Naofumi’s time to shine, nano!”
“Go get ’em!”
“Just watching is so frustrating. I understand exactly how Sakura-chan feels.”

After that, Father alternated between a shield with a status-ailment counter effect and one that countered with lightning element, tossing in healing magic here and there, and fought a fine battle against the Blue Shark Robbery, indeed. At one point he even leapt clean out of the water, chained an Air Strike Shield into a Change Shield to hook the Blue Shark Robbery’s mouth like a fisherman reeling in a catch—quite the display, indeed. Eventually, whether it had reached its stamina limit or been worn down by poison or the like, the Blue Shark Robbery’s movements slowed, then stopped entirely, and its form vanished, indeed. Defeated, presumably.
“Victory, but… yeah, doing this alone really does take a while, huh.”
Father said this while catching the light that appeared after the Blue Shark Robbery disappeared.
“Let’s see… a drop item, huh. Blue Shark Robbery Shield… I wonder how I feel about a counter effect that includes Steal?”
“Sounds handy. I got a weapon unlocked too—something called the Frozen Cock Knife.”
Ren too, huh? Neither Itsuki nor I got anything, indeed.
“And then there’s… Water Gene? An accessory with an ability-awakening effect for people of the water attribute…?”

Father checked the screen as he returned to the portal point, came back to us, and pulled a bracelet-type accessory out from his shield. Checking it over… it displayed an effect that boosted the abilities of anyone with an affinity for the water attribute, indeed. Water attribute… that was Fiancée’s specialty in magic. Meaning, if Fiancée equipped this, her abilities would increase dramatically?
“Perhaps this is meant for Fiancée?”
“Huh? But I’ve already got that weird compact I was given—isn’t that enough?”
Fiancée held up the compact to show us. A trinket made by Rival, indeed.
“Unlike that oddity Gaelion-san made, this is more like an artifact obtained from a hero-exclusive spot. It’s on a completely different level.”
“Even Bow Hero’s being harsh, nano.”
It seemed to have several other effects besides, indeed.
